title: The hub starts a direction with no project repo — without --repo (the core makes its git folder), not in its own folder and not with a hand-made git init; with a project repo — --repo to it
note: The system prompt is hub-home/CLAUDE.md of the version. Case: the hub created a direction for a topic with no project (a data product from a chat): mkdir + git init without a commit, `hub direction new <slug> --repo <that folder>`, then `hub task run <slug>` without --repo — the direction came up in the hub's own folder (not git), worked by itself and could not become a mini-hub. Since the fix the core gives a direction without --repo its own git folder with a commit, and `hub task run <slug>` takes the direction's repo. Control — a project with its own repo: --repo to it stays.
